id-20261027-news-3.title: Free Nutritious Meal Program and the 2027 Budget: Assessing Food Safety, Targeting Accuracy, and Spending Efficiency

segments.src: Program Makan Bergizi Gratis (MBG) menjadi salah satu program prioritas pemerintah dan menyerap porsi besar belanja negara.
segments.tr: The Free Nutritious Meal (MBG) program has become one of the government's priority programs and absorbs a large portion of state spending.

segments.src: Tujuannya jelas: memperbaiki asupan gizi anak sekolah, ibu hamil, dan kelompok rentan lainnya.
segments.tr: The goal is clear: to improve the nutritional intake of school children, pregnant women, and other vulnerable groups.

segments.src: Namun seiring skala program yang membesar, pertanyaan publik pun bergeser dari "apakah program ini baik?"
segments.tr: However, as the scale of the program grows, public questions have shifted from "is this program good?"

segments.src: menjadi "apakah belanjanya berjalan aman, tepat sasaran, dan efisien?"
segments.tr: to "is the spending safe, well-targeted, and efficient?"

segments.src: Artikel ini bersifat informatif.
segments.tr: This article is informative in nature.

segments.src: Ia tidak menilai pihak tertentu, melainkan mengajak pembaca memahami isu utama dan indikator yang dapat dipakai untuk menilai kinerja program menjelang pembahasan anggaran 2027.
segments.tr: It does not judge any specific party, but rather invites readers to understand the main issues and indicators that can be used to assess the program's performance ahead of the 2027 budget discussions.

segments.src: Angka dan kebijakan terbaru sebaiknya selalu dicek ke sumber resmi, seperti dokumen APBN dan laporan Badan Gizi Nasional (BGN).
segments.tr: The latest figures and policies should always be checked against official sources, such as state budget (APBN) documents and reports from the National Nutrition Agency (BGN).

segments.src: ## Mengapa Anggaran MBG Layak Dicermati
segments.tr: ## Why the MBG Budget Deserves Scrutiny

segments.src: Program berskala nasional dengan jutaan penerima manfaat membutuhkan dana besar, rantai pasok yang rapi, dan pengawasan yang konsisten.
segments.tr: A national-scale program with millions of beneficiaries requires large funds, a well-organized supply chain, and consistent oversight.

segments.src: Ada tiga alasan mengapa belanja MBG pantas diperhatikan:
segments.tr: There are three reasons why MBG spending deserves attention:

segments.src: - **Porsi anggaran yang besar.** Setiap rupiah yang dialokasikan ke MBG berarti ruang fiskal yang tidak dipakai untuk kebutuhan lain, seperti kesehatan, pendidikan, atau infrastruktur. Karena itu, efektivitasnya perlu diuji.
segments.tr: - **A large budget portion.** Every rupiah allocated to MBG means fiscal space that is not used for other needs, such as health, education, or infrastructure. Therefore, its effectiveness needs to be tested.

segments.src: - **Dampak langsung pada kesehatan.** Berbeda dengan banyak program lain, MBG menyangkut makanan yang dikonsumsi langsung oleh anak-anak. Kesalahan kecil dalam pengolahan dapat berdampak nyata.
segments.tr: - **Direct impact on health.** Unlike many other programs, MBG involves food consumed directly by children. Small mistakes in processing can have real impacts.

segments.src: - **Pelaksanaan melibatkan banyak pihak.** Pemerintah pusat dan daerah, penyedia dapur, pemasok bahan pangan, sekolah, hingga orang tua semuanya berperan. Semakin banyak pihak, semakin penting koordinasi dan akuntabilitasnya.
segments.tr: - **Implementation involves many parties.** Central and regional governments, kitchen providers, food suppliers, schools, and parents all play a role. The more parties involved, the more important coordination and accountability become.

segments.src: ## Keamanan Pangan di Dapur Penyedia
segments.tr: ## Food Safety in Provider Kitchens

segments.src: Isu yang paling sering mendapat perhatian adalah keamanan pangan.
segments.tr: The issue that most often receives attention is food safety.

segments.src: Selama pelaksanaan program, publik beberapa kali mendengar laporan kasus keluhan kesehatan, seperti mual dan sakit perut, yang diduga terkait makanan yang dibagikan.
segments.tr: During the program's implementation, the public has heard reports of health complaints several times, such as nausea and stomach aches, which are suspected to be related to the food distributed.

segments.src: Setiap kasus perlu diverifikasi melalui penyelidikan resmi, dan tidak semua dugaan terbukti berkaitan dengan program.
segments.tr: Every case needs to be verified through an official investigation, and not all allegations are proven to be related to the program.

segments.src: Meski begitu, kejadian semacam ini menunjukkan pentingnya sistem pencegahan yang kuat.
segments.tr: Even so, such incidents demonstrate the importance of a strong prevention system.

segments.src: Beberapa titik rawan yang umum ditemukan dalam penyediaan makanan skala besar:
segments.tr: Some common vulnerable points found in large-scale food provision:

segments.src: 1. **Jeda waktu antara memasak dan menyantap.** Makanan yang dimasak terlalu dini lalu disimpan lama pada suhu ruang lebih mudah terkontaminasi bakteri. Semakin jauh jarak dapur dari sekolah, semakin penting pengaturan jadwal masak dan pengemasan.
segments.tr: 1. **Time gap between cooking and eating.** Food cooked too early and then stored for a long time at room temperature is more easily contaminated by bacteria. The further the distance from the kitchen to the school, the more important the scheduling of cooking and packaging becomes.

segments.src: 2. **Kebersihan fasilitas dan petugas.** Sanitasi dapur, ketersediaan air bersih, pemisahan bahan mentah dan matang, serta kebiasaan higienis petugas sangat menentukan mutu makanan.
segments.tr: 2. **Facility and staff cleanliness.** Kitchen sanitation, availability of clean water, separation of raw and cooked ingredients, and the hygienic habits of staff are crucial in determining food quality.

segments.src: 3. **Kualitas dan penyimpanan bahan baku.** Bahan segar seperti ikan, ayam, telur, dan sayur memerlukan rantai dingin dan penyimpanan yang benar.
segments.tr: 3. **Quality and storage of raw materials.** Fresh ingredients such as fish, chicken, eggs, and vegetables require a cold chain and proper storage.

segments.src: 4. **Kapasitas dapur.** Dapur yang melayani porsi melebihi kemampuan berisiko memangkas tahapan keamanan demi mengejar waktu.
segments.tr: 4. **Kitchen capacity.** Kitchens serving portions beyond their capacity risk cutting safety steps to save time.

segments.src: 5. **Pelatihan dan sertifikasi.** Penjamah makanan perlu memahami prinsip keamanan pangan, dan dapur idealnya memiliki sertifikat laik higiene sanitasi serta mengikuti standar seperti HACCP.
segments.tr: 5. **Training and certification.** Food handlers need to understand food safety principles, and kitchens should ideally have a sanitation hygiene certificate and follow standards such as HACCP.

segments.src: Pendekatan yang sering direkomendasikan para pakar keamanan pangan adalah pengawasan berlapis: inspeksi berkala oleh dinas kesehatan, pengambilan sampel makanan (sampel pembanding) yang disimpan untuk keperluan penelusuran, pencatatan suhu dan waktu produksi, serta mekanisme pelaporan insiden yang cepat dan terbuka.
segments.tr: The approach often recommended by food safety experts is layered oversight: periodic inspections by the health department, taking food samples (reference samples) stored for tracing purposes, recording production temperatures and times, and a fast and open incident reporting mechanism.

segments.src: ## Tantangan Distribusi dan Ketepatan Sasaran
segments.tr: ## Distribution Challenges and Targeting Accuracy

segments.src: Menyalurkan makanan ke jutaan penerima di ribuan lokasi bukan pekerjaan sederhana.
segments.tr: Distributing food to millions of recipients in thousands of locations is not a simple task.

segments.src: Tantangannya berbeda di tiap wilayah.
segments.tr: The challenges differ in each region.

segments.src: - **Kondisi geografis.** Wilayah kepulauan, pegunungan, dan daerah terpencil menghadapi biaya logistik lebih tinggi dan risiko keterlambatan yang lebih besar.
segments.tr: - **Geographical conditions.** Archipelagic, mountainous, and remote areas face higher logistics costs and greater risks of delays.

segments.src: - **Pemetaan penerima.** Ketepatan sasaran bergantung pada data yang mutakhir: jumlah siswa, kelompok ibu hamil dan menyusui, serta balita. Data yang tidak sinkron dapat menyebabkan makanan berlebih di satu tempat dan kekurangan di tempat lain.
segments.tr: - **Recipient mapping.** Targeting accuracy depends on up-to-date data: the number of students, groups of pregnant and breastfeeding women, and toddlers. Asynchronous data can lead to excess food in one place and shortages in another.

segments.src: - **Pemerataan dapur.** Pembangunan dapur penyedia cenderung lebih cepat di wilayah yang infrastrukturnya sudah baik. Jika tidak diimbangi, daerah dengan kebutuhan gizi tinggi justru bisa tertinggal.
segments.tr: - **Kitchen distribution.** The construction of provider kitchens tends to be faster in areas with good infrastructure. If not balanced, areas with high nutritional needs could be left behind.

segments.src: - **Pemanfaatan pangan lokal.** Menggunakan bahan dari petani dan pelaku usaha setempat dapat memperpendek rantai pasok sekaligus menggerakkan ekonomi daerah, tetapi membutuhkan pasokan yang stabil dan mutu yang terjaga.
segments.tr: - **Utilization of local food.** Using ingredients from local farmers and businesses can shorten the supply chain while boosting the local economy, but it requires stable supply and maintained quality.

segments.src: - **Variasi menu dan penerimaan anak.** Makanan yang bergizi namun tidak dihabiskan anak tidak memberi manfaat penuh. Sisa makanan yang tinggi menjadi sinyal bahwa menu perlu disesuaikan dengan selera dan budaya setempat.
segments.tr: - **Menu variation and child acceptance.** Nutritious food that is not finished by children does not provide full benefits. High food waste is a signal that the menu needs to be adjusted to local tastes and culture.

segments.src: ## Efisiensi Belanja: Apa yang Perlu Diukur
segments.tr: ## Spending Efficiency: What Needs to be Measured

segments.src: Efisiensi tidak sama dengan penghematan semata.
segments.tr: Efficiency is not the same as mere savings.

segments.src: Belanja yang efisien berarti hasil yang dicapai sebanding, atau lebih baik, dibanding dana yang dikeluarkan.
segments.tr: Efficient spending means the results achieved are comparable, or better, than the funds spent.

segments.src: Beberapa komponen biaya yang lazim dibahas antara lain bahan baku, tenaga kerja dapur, distribusi, peralatan, serta biaya pengawasan dan administrasi.
segments.tr: Some cost components commonly discussed include raw materials, kitchen labor, distribution, equipment, as well as supervision and administrative costs.

segments.src: Pertanyaan yang relevan diajukan antara lain:
segments.tr: Relevant questions to ask include:

segments.src: - Berapa biaya per porsi, dan bagaimana perbandingannya antardaerah dengan memperhitungkan perbedaan harga bahan pangan?
segments.tr: - What is the cost per portion, and how does it compare between regions, taking into account differences in food prices?

segments.src: - Seberapa besar porsi anggaran yang benar-benar menjadi makanan dibanding biaya operasional dan administrasi?
segments.tr: - How much of the budget portion actually becomes food compared to operational and administrative costs?

segments.src: - Apakah penyerapan anggaran berjalan seimbang dengan kesiapan di lapangan, atau ada dana yang tertahan karena dapur belum siap?
segments.tr: - Is budget absorption balanced with readiness in the field, or are funds held up because kitchens are not ready?

segments.src: - Apakah ada mekanisme pengadaan yang transparan sehingga mengurangi risiko penyimpangan dan harga yang tidak wajar?
segments.tr: - Is there a transparent procurement mechanism to reduce the risk of irregularities and unreasonable prices?

segments.src: ## Indikator yang Dapat Dipakai Publik
segments.tr: ## Indicators the Public Can Use

segments.src: Masyarakat tidak perlu menjadi ahli anggaran untuk ikut memantau.
segments.tr: The public does not need to be a budget expert to participate in monitoring.

segments.src: Berikut indikator sederhana yang dapat dijadikan tolok ukur, sebagian besar dapat ditelusuri dari laporan resmi pemerintah, lembaga audit, maupun pemberitaan yang kredibel:
segments.tr: The following are simple indicators that can be used as benchmarks, most of which can be traced from official government reports, audit institutions, and credible news reports:

segments.src: | Aspek | Indikator yang bisa dicermati |
segments.tr: | Aspect | Indicators to observe |

segments.src: | Keamanan pangan | Jumlah dan penanganan insiden keracunan; persentase dapur bersertifikat higiene sanitasi; frekuensi inspeksi |
segments.tr: | Food safety | Number and handling of poisoning incidents; percentage of kitchens with sanitation hygiene certification; frequency of inspections |

segments.src: | Ketepatan sasaran | Cakupan penerima dibanding target; sebaran dapur antarwilayah; kesesuaian data penerima |
segments.tr: | Targeting accuracy | Recipient coverage compared to target; kitchen distribution across regions; accuracy of recipient data |

segments.src: | Kualitas gizi | Kesesuaian menu dengan pedoman gizi; variasi menu; tingkat sisa makanan |
segments.tr: | Nutritional quality | Menu compliance with nutritional guidelines; menu variation; food waste levels |

segments.src: | Efisiensi | Biaya per porsi; rasio belanja makanan terhadap biaya operasional; tingkat penyerapan anggaran |
segments.tr: | Efficiency | Cost per portion; ratio of food spending to operational costs; budget absorption rate |

segments.src: | Akuntabilitas | Hasil audit BPK dan pengawasan internal; ketersediaan kanal pengaduan; keterbukaan laporan |
segments.tr: | Accountability | BPK audit results and internal oversight; availability of complaint channels; report transparency |

segments.src: | Dampak jangka panjang | Tren status gizi anak, angka tengkes (stunting), kehadiran dan konsentrasi belajar |
segments.tr: | Long-term impact | Trends in child nutritional status, stunting rates, attendance, and learning concentration |

segments.src: Perlu diingat bahwa dampak gizi bersifat jangka panjang.
segments.tr: It should be remembered that nutritional impacts are long-term.

segments.src: Perubahan status gizi anak tidak terlihat dalam hitungan minggu, sehingga evaluasi yang adil memerlukan data berkala dan metode yang konsisten, bukan hanya cuplikan kasus tunggal, baik yang positif maupun negatif.
segments.tr: Changes in children's nutritional status are not visible in a matter of weeks, so a fair evaluation requires periodic data and consistent methods, not just single case snippets, whether positive or negative.

segments.src: ## Peran Pengawasan dan Partisipasi Publik
segments.tr: ## The Role of Oversight and Public Participation

segments.src: Pengawasan yang efektif tidak hanya datang dari lembaga negara.
segments.tr: Effective oversight does not only come from state institutions.

segments.src: Orang tua, guru, dan komite sekolah dapat membantu dengan mengamati kondisi makanan yang diterima, melaporkan keluhan melalui kanal resmi, dan menyampaikan masukan soal menu.
segments.tr: Parents, teachers, and school committees can help by observing the condition of the food received, reporting complaints through official channels, and providing input on the menu.

segments.src: DPR, BPK, serta lembaga pemerhati kebijakan publik juga berperan menguji asumsi anggaran dan hasil pelaksanaan.
segments.tr: The DPR, BPK, and public policy observer institutions also play a role in testing budget assumptions and implementation results.

segments.src: Keterbukaan data, misalnya sebaran dapur, realisasi anggaran, dan hasil inspeksi, akan memudahkan semua pihak menilai program secara objektif.
segments.tr: Data openness, for example, kitchen distribution, budget realization, and inspection results, will make it easier for all parties to assess the program objectively.

segments.src: ## Penutup
segments.tr: ## Closing

segments.src: Anggaran 2027 menjadi momentum untuk menimbang ulang bagaimana MBG dijalankan: tidak sekadar seberapa besar dana yang dialokasikan, tetapi seberapa aman makanan yang disajikan, seberapa tepat sasaran penyalurannya, dan seberapa efisien setiap rupiah dibelanjakan.
segments.tr: The 2027 budget is a momentum to reconsider how MBG is run: not just how much funding is allocated, but how safe the food served is, how well-targeted the distribution is, and how efficiently every rupiah is spent.

segments.src: Program dengan tujuan baik tetap perlu diuji dengan data dan pengawasan yang terbuka agar manfaatnya benar-benar dirasakan anak-anak Indonesia.
segments.tr: A program with good intentions still needs to be tested with data and open oversight so that its benefits are truly felt by Indonesian children.

id-20261027-news-1.title: Ahead of the Q3 2026 GDP Release: How to Read BPS Economic Growth Figures and Sectors Worth Watching

segments.src: Badan Pusat Statistik (BPS) dijadwalkan mengumumkan angka pertumbuhan ekonomi kuartal III pada awal November.
segments.tr: Statistics Indonesia (BPS) is scheduled to announce the third-quarter economic growth figures in early November.

segments.src: Setiap kali rilis ini keluar, judul berita biasanya hanya memuat satu angka, misalnya "ekonomi tumbuh sekian persen".
segments.tr: Every time this release comes out, news headlines usually only contain one number, for example "the economy grew by X percent".

segments.src: Padahal angka itu punya banyak lapisan.
segments.tr: In reality, that number has many layers.

segments.src: Artikel ini membantu pembaca awam memahami apa yang sebenarnya diukur, bagaimana membedakan istilah yang sering muncul, dan bagian mana dari laporan yang layak dicermati.
segments.tr: This article helps lay readers understand what is actually being measured, how to distinguish between frequently appearing terms, and which parts of the report are worth watching.

segments.src: ## Apa yang diukur oleh PDB?
segments.tr: ## What does GDP measure?

segments.src: Produk Domestik Bruto (PDB) adalah nilai seluruh barang dan jasa akhir yang dihasilkan di wilayah Indonesia dalam periode tertentu.
segments.tr: Gross Domestic Product (GDP) is the value of all final goods and services produced within the territory of Indonesia in a certain period.

segments.src: BPS menghitungnya dengan tiga pendekatan yang hasilnya semestinya sejalan:
segments.tr: BPS calculates it using three approaches whose results should be consistent:

segments.src: - **Pendekatan produksi**: menjumlahkan nilai tambah dari setiap lapangan usaha, seperti pertanian, industri pengolahan, perdagangan, dan jasa.
segments.tr: - **Production approach**: summing the value added from each business sector, such as agriculture, manufacturing, trade, and services.

segments.src: - **Pendekatan pengeluaran**: menjumlahkan konsumsi, investasi, belanja pemerintah, dan ekspor, lalu dikurangi impor.
segments.tr: - **Expenditure approach**: summing consumption, investment, government spending, and exports, then subtracting imports.

segments.src: - **Pendekatan pendapatan**: menjumlahkan balas jasa yang diterima pekerja, pemilik modal, dan pihak lain.
segments.tr: - **Income approach**: summing the compensation received by workers, capital owners, and other parties.

segments.src: Berita sehari-hari paling sering memakai dua pendekatan pertama.
segments.tr: Daily news most often uses the first two approaches.

segments.src: Keduanya saling melengkapi: yang pertama menjawab "sektor apa yang bergerak", yang kedua menjawab "siapa yang membelanjakan".
segments.tr: Both complement each other: the first answers "what sectors are moving", the second answers "who is spending".

segments.src: ## Membedakan year-on-year, quarter-to-quarter, dan cumulative
segments.tr: ## Distinguishing between year-on-year, quarter-to-quarter, and cumulative

segments.src: Kebingungan paling umum muncul dari tiga istilah ini.
segments.tr: The most common confusion arises from these three terms.

segments.src: Ketiganya mengukur hal yang berbeda, sehingga angkanya bisa sangat berbeda pula.
segments.tr: All three measure different things, so the numbers can also be very different.

segments.src: ### Year-on-year (y-on-y)
segments.tr: ### Year-on-year (y-on-y)

segments.src: Membandingkan kuartal III 2026 dengan kuartal III 2025.
segments.tr: Comparing Q3 2026 with Q3 2025.

segments.src: Angka ini yang biasanya dijadikan "angka utama" pertumbuhan ekonomi.
segments.tr: This figure is usually used as the "headline figure" for economic growth.

segments.src: Karena membandingkan kuartal yang sama di tahun berbeda, pola musiman seperti panen, libur panjang, dan hari raya relatif ikut terhapus dari perbandingan.
segments.tr: Because it compares the same quarter in different years, seasonal patterns such as harvests, long holidays, and festive seasons are relatively removed from the comparison.

segments.src: ### Quarter-to-quarter (q-to-q)
segments.tr: ### Quarter-to-quarter (q-to-q)

segments.src: Membandingkan kuartal III 2026 dengan kuartal II 2026.
segments.tr: Comparing Q3 2026 with Q2 2026.

segments.src: Angka ini menunjukkan momentum jangka pendek, tetapi sangat dipengaruhi pola musiman.
segments.tr: This figure shows short-term momentum, but is heavily influenced by seasonal patterns.

segments.src: Pertumbuhan q-to-q yang rendah atau bahkan negatif pada kuartal tertentu tidak otomatis berarti ekonomi memburuk.
segments.tr: Low or even negative q-to-q growth in a certain quarter does not automatically mean the economy is worsening.

segments.src: Bisa jadi itu hanya pola yang memang berulang setiap tahun.
segments.tr: It could just be a pattern that repeats every year.

segments.src: ### Kumulatif (c-to-c)
segments.tr: ### Cumulative (c-to-c)

segments.src: Membandingkan akumulasi kuartal I hingga III 2026 dengan periode yang sama pada 2025.
segments.tr: Comparing the accumulation of Q1 to Q3 2026 with the same period in 2025.

segments.src: Angka ini meredam fluktuasi satu kuartal dan lebih mencerminkan tren sepanjang tahun berjalan.
segments.tr: This figure dampens single-quarter fluctuations and better reflects the trend throughout the current year.

segments.src: **Contoh sederhana:** Bayangkan sebuah warung yang omzetnya selalu melonjak menjelang hari raya.
segments.tr: **Simple example:** Imagine a shop whose turnover always spikes ahead of a festive season.

segments.src: Membandingkan omzet bulan hari raya dengan bulan sebelumnya akan tampak melesat, padahal itu pola tahunan.
segments.tr: Comparing the festive month's turnover with the previous month will look like a surge, even though it's an annual pattern.

segments.src: Membandingkan dengan bulan hari raya tahun lalu memberi gambaran yang lebih adil.
segments.tr: Comparing it with the festive month of the previous year provides a fairer picture.

segments.src: Logika yang sama berlaku pada PDB.
segments.tr: The same logic applies to GDP.

segments.src: ## Harga berlaku dan harga konstan
segments.tr: ## Current prices and constant prices

segments.src: BPS menerbitkan PDB dalam dua versi.
segments.tr: BPS publishes GDP in two versions.

segments.src: PDB atas dasar harga berlaku mencerminkan nilai dengan harga saat itu, sehingga ikut naik ketika harga-harga naik.
segments.tr: GDP at current prices reflects the value at prices at that time, so it rises when prices rise.

segments.src: PDB atas dasar harga konstan menghilangkan efek inflasi, sehingga lebih tepat untuk menilai pertumbuhan riil.
segments.tr: GDP at constant prices removes the effect of inflation, making it more appropriate for assessing real growth.

segments.src: Angka pertumbuhan ekonomi yang dikutip media adalah pertumbuhan atas dasar harga konstan.
segments.tr: The economic growth figure cited by the media is growth at constant prices.

segments.src: ## Tiga penggerak dari sisi pengeluaran
segments.tr: ## Three drivers from the expenditure side

segments.src: ### 1. Konsumsi rumah tangga
segments.tr: ### 1. Household consumption

segments.src: Komponen ini merupakan yang terbesar dalam struktur PDB Indonesia, dengan porsi yang selama ini berada di kisaran lebih dari separuh.
segments.tr: This component is the largest in Indonesia's GDP structure, with a portion that has consistently been in the range of more than half.

segments.src: Karena porsinya besar, perubahan kecil pada konsumsi rumah tangga bisa menggeser angka pertumbuhan secara keseluruhan.
segments.tr: Because its portion is large, small changes in household consumption can shift the overall growth figure.

segments.src: Hal yang layak diperhatikan:
segments.tr: Things worth noting:

segments.src: - **Laju pertumbuhannya** dibandingkan kuartal-kuartal sebelumnya, bukan sekadar naik atau turun.
segments.tr: - **Its growth rate** compared to previous quarters, not just whether it went up or down.

segments.src: - **Rincian kelompok pengeluaran**, misalnya makanan dan minuman, transportasi dan komunikasi, restoran dan hotel, serta pakaian.
segments.tr: - **Details of expenditure groups**, for example food and beverages, transportation and communication, restaurants and hotels, and clothing.

segments.src: - **Indikator pendukung** seperti inflasi, penciptaan lapangan kerja, dan survei keyakinan konsumen yang diterbitkan Bank Indonesia.
segments.tr: - **Supporting indicators** such as inflation, job creation, and the consumer confidence survey published by Bank Indonesia.

segments.src: ### 2. Investasi (Pembentukan Modal Tetap Bruto)
segments.tr: ### 2. Investment (Gross Fixed Capital Formation)

segments.src: Investasi dalam PDB tercatat sebagai Pembentukan Modal Tetap Bruto (PMTB), yaitu pengeluaran untuk bangunan, mesin, kendaraan, dan peralatan.
segments.tr: Investment in GDP is recorded as Gross Fixed Capital Formation (GFCF), which is expenditure on buildings, machinery, vehicles, and equipment.

segments.src: Porsinya biasanya sekitar seperempat lebih dari PDB.
segments.tr: Its portion is usually around more than a quarter of GDP.

segments.src: Investasi penting karena membentuk kapasitas produksi masa depan.
segments.tr: Investment is important because it builds future production capacity.

segments.src: Hal yang layak diperhatikan:
segments.tr: Things worth noting:

segments.src: - Komposisi antara **bangunan** dan **non-bangunan** (mesin dan peralatan). Pertumbuhan non-bangunan sering dibaca sebagai tanda dunia usaha menambah kapasitas.
segments.tr: - Composition between **buildings** and **non-buildings** (machinery and equipment). Non-building growth is often read as a sign that the business world is increasing capacity.

segments.src: - Pengaruh proyek infrastruktur dan belanja modal pemerintah.
segments.tr: - The influence of infrastructure projects and government capital expenditure.

segments.src: - Perbedaan antara data PMTB di PDB dan data realisasi investasi (PMA dan PMDN) dari kementerian terkait. Keduanya tidak identik karena definisi dan cakupannya berbeda.
segments.tr: - The difference between GFCF data in GDP and investment realization data (FDI and DDI) from the relevant ministry. Both are not identical because their definitions and scopes differ.

segments.src: ### 3. Ekspor dan impor
segments.tr: ### 3. Exports and imports

segments.src: Ekspor menambah PDB, sedangkan impor mengurangnya.
segments.tr: Exports add to GDP, while imports subtract from it.

segments.src: Yang masuk hitungan PDB adalah **ekspor neto**, yaitu ekspor dikurangi impor.
segments.tr: What is included in the GDP calculation is **net exports**, which is exports minus imports.

segments.src: Karena itu, impor yang naik tidak selalu kabar buruk.
segments.tr: Therefore, rising imports are not always bad news.

segments.src: Impor bahan baku dan barang modal yang meningkat bisa mencerminkan aktivitas industri dan investasi yang menggeliat.
segments.tr: Increasing imports of raw materials and capital goods can reflect industrial activity and investment that are picking up.

segments.src: Hal yang layak diperhatikan:
segments.tr: Things worth noting:

segments.src: - Perkembangan harga komoditas global yang memengaruhi nilai ekspor, terutama batu bara, minyak sawit, dan produk logam.
segments.tr: - Global commodity price developments that affect export value, especially coal, palm oil, and metal products.

segments.src: - Permintaan dari mitra dagang utama.
segments.tr: - Demand from major trading partners.

segments.src: - Kinerja ekspor jasa, termasuk pariwisata.
segments.tr: - Performance of service exports, including tourism.

segments.src: ### Komponen lain: belanja pemerintah
segments.tr: ### Other components: government spending

segments.src: Konsumsi pemerintah dan belanja negara juga ikut membentuk PDB.
segments.tr: Government consumption and state spending also help form GDP.

segments.src: Pola realisasi anggaran sepanjang tahun dapat memengaruhi angka kuartal tertentu.
segments.tr: The pattern of budget realization throughout the year can affect specific quarterly figures.

segments.src: ## Sektor yang layak dicermati pembaca awam
segments.tr: ## Sectors worth watching for lay readers

segments.src: Dari sisi lapangan usaha, beberapa sektor biasanya menjadi sorotan karena porsinya besar atau karena menyerap banyak tenaga kerja:
segments.tr: From the business field side, several sectors usually become the spotlight because of their large portion or because they absorb a lot of labor:

segments.src: - **Industri pengolahan**: sektor dengan kontribusi terbesar terhadap PDB. Kinerjanya sering dibaca bersama indeks manajer pembelian (PMI) manufaktur.
segments.tr: - **Manufacturing industry**: the sector with the largest contribution to GDP. Its performance is often read alongside the manufacturing purchasing managers' index (PMI).

segments.src: - **Pertanian, kehutanan, dan perikanan**: penting bagi penyerapan tenaga kerja dan sangat dipengaruhi musim panen serta cuaca.
segments.tr: - **Agriculture, forestry, and fishing**: important for labor absorption and heavily influenced by harvest seasons and weather.

segments.src: - **Perdagangan besar dan eceran**: cermin dari aktivitas konsumsi dan distribusi.
segments.tr: - **Wholesale and retail trade**: a mirror of consumption and distribution activities.

segments.src: - **Pertambangan dan penggalian**: peka terhadap harga dan permintaan komoditas global.
segments.tr: - **Mining and quarrying**: sensitive to global commodity prices and demand.

segments.src: - **Konstruksi**: terkait erat dengan investasi dan proyek infrastruktur.
segments.tr: - **Construction**: closely related to investment and infrastructure projects.

segments.src: - **Informasi dan komunikasi**: sektor yang tumbuh seiring digitalisasi.
segments.tr: - **Information and communication**: a sector that grows along with digitalization.

segments.src: - **Transportasi dan pergudangan serta akomodasi dan makan minum**: kerap terdorong oleh mobilitas masyarakat dan pariwisata.
segments.tr: - **Transportation and warehousing as well as accommodation and food and beverage**: often driven by public mobility and tourism.

segments.src: Cara praktis membacanya: lihat sektor mana yang tumbuh di atas rata-rata ekonomi dan mana yang tertinggal, lalu cocokkan dengan sektor tempat Anda atau lingkungan Anda bergantung.
segments.tr: A practical way to read it: look at which sectors are growing above the economic average and which are lagging, then match it with the sector you or your environment depends on.

segments.src: ## Cara membaca rilis BPS secara kritis
segments.tr: ## How to read BPS releases critically

segments.src: 1. **Baca siaran pers lengkapnya.** Judul berita sering memangkas konteks. Siaran pers BPS memuat rincian per sektor dan per komponen pengeluaran.
segments.tr: 1. **Read the full press release.** News headlines often trim the context. BPS press releases contain details per sector and per expenditure component.

segments.src: 2. **Bandingkan dengan tren, bukan satu titik.** Satu kuartal yang sedikit lebih tinggi atau lebih rendah dari perkiraan belum tentu mengubah gambaran besar.
segments.tr: 2. **Compare with trends, not a single point.** One quarter that is slightly higher or lower than expected does not necessarily change the big picture.

segments.src: 3. **Perhatikan revisi.** BPS dapat merevisi angka kuartal sebelumnya ketika data baru tersedia. Itu praktik normal dalam statistik.
segments.tr: 3. **Pay attention to revisions.** BPS may revise previous quarter figures when new data becomes available. That is normal practice in statistics.

segments.src: 4. **Pahami efek basis.** Jika kuartal yang sama tahun lalu sangat tinggi atau rendah, angka y-on-y tahun ini akan ikut terpengaruh.
segments.tr: 4. **Understand the base effect.** If the same quarter last year was very high or low, this year's y-on-y figure will be affected.

segments.src: 5. **Bedakan prediksi dan realisasi.** Proyeksi ekonom, lembaga internasional, dan pemerintah adalah perkiraan. Hanya rilis BPS yang menjadi angka resmi.
segments.tr: 5. **Distinguish between forecasts and realization.** Projections by economists, international institutions, and the government are estimates. Only BPS releases are official figures.

segments.src: 6. **Waspadai tafsir tunggal.** Angka PDB adalah rata-rata nasional. Kondisi tiap daerah, kelompok pendapatan, dan sektor bisa sangat berbeda dari angka agregat.
segments.tr: 6. **Beware of single interpretations.** GDP figures are national averages. Conditions in each region, income group, and sector can be very different from the aggregate figure.

segments.src: ## Apa artinya bagi kehidupan sehari-hari?
segments.tr: ## What does it mean for daily life?

segments.src: PDB bukan ukuran kesejahteraan yang lengkap.
segments.tr: GDP is not a complete measure of well-being.

segments.src: Angka itu tidak langsung menggambarkan pendapatan keluarga, harga di pasar, atau kesempatan kerja.
segments.tr: That number does not directly describe family income, prices in the market, or job opportunities.

segments.src: Meski begitu, pertumbuhan yang stabil umumnya berkaitan dengan terbukanya lapangan kerja, penerimaan negara, dan kapasitas dunia usaha untuk berekspansi.
segments.tr: Even so, stable growth is generally related to job creation, state revenue, and the business world's capacity to expand.

segments.src: Karena itu, angka pertumbuhan perlu dibaca bersama indikator lain seperti inflasi, tingkat pengangguran, dan daya beli.
segments.tr: Therefore, growth figures need to be read alongside other indicators such as inflation, unemployment rates, and purchasing power.

segments.src: ## Kesimpulan
segments.tr: ## Conclusion

segments.src: Saat rilis PDB kuartal III diumumkan, jangan berhenti pada satu angka di judul berita.
segments.tr: When the Q3 GDP release is announced, don't stop at one number in the news headline.

segments.src: Periksa dulu apakah angka itu y-on-y, q-to-q, atau kumulatif.
segments.tr: Check first whether the number is y-on-y, q-to-q, or cumulative.

segments.src: Lihat komponen konsumsi rumah tangga, investasi, dan ekspor neto yang membentuknya.
segments.tr: Look at the household consumption, investment, and net export components that form it.

segments.src: Cermati juga sektor-sektor yang menjadi pendorong atau penahan.
segments.tr: Also observe the sectors that are drivers or drags.

segments.src: Dengan cara itu, pembaca awam dapat memahami kondisi ekonomi secara lebih utuh dan tidak mudah terbawa tafsir yang berlebihan.
segments.tr: In that way, lay readers can understand the economic condition more holistically and not be easily carried away by excessive interpretations.

id-20261027-news-2.title: 2027 Minimum Wage: How the UMP/UMK Formula Works and the Tug-of-War Between Workers and Employers

segments.src: Menjelang akhir tahun, pembahasan upah minimum kembali menjadi salah satu isu ekonomi yang paling disorot.
segments.tr: Towards the end of the year, the discussion on minimum wage becomes one of the most highlighted economic issues.

segments.src: Pemerintah daerah, dewan pengupahan, serikat pekerja, dan asosiasi pengusaha mulai menghitung dan menyampaikan usulan untuk upah minimum 2027.
segments.tr: Regional governments, wage councils, labor unions, and business associations have begun calculating and submitting proposals for the 2027 minimum wage.

segments.src: Bagi jutaan pekerja, angka ini menentukan daya beli rumah tangga.
segments.tr: For millions of workers, this figure determines household purchasing power.

segments.src: Bagi dunia usaha, angka yang sama menentukan struktur biaya produksi.
segments.tr: For the business world, the same figure determines production cost structures.

segments.src: Artikel ini menjelaskan cara kerja rumus upah minimum, tahapan penetapannya, serta argumen dari kedua belah pihak.
segments.tr: This article explains how the minimum wage formula works, the stages of its determination, and the arguments from both sides.

segments.src: Tujuannya membantu pembaca memahami proses di balik pengumuman angka kenaikan.
segments.tr: The goal is to help readers understand the process behind the announcement of the increase figures.

segments.src: > **Catatan:** Aturan pengupahan beberapa kali berubah, baik lewat peraturan pemerintah maupun putusan Mahkamah Konstitusi. Rincian di bawah ini bersifat umum. Untuk angka dan tenggat resmi, rujuklah pengumuman pemerintah pusat dan pemerintah daerah setempat.
segments.tr: > **Note:** Wage regulations have changed several times, both through government regulations and Constitutional Court rulings. The details below are general in nature. For official figures and deadlines, please refer to announcements from the central government and local regional governments.

segments.src: ## Apa Itu UMP dan UMK?
segments.tr: ## What Are UMP and UMK?

segments.src: - **Upah Minimum Provinsi (UMP)** adalah batas bawah upah bulanan yang berlaku di seluruh wilayah suatu provinsi. Gubernur menetapkannya.
segments.tr: - **Provincial Minimum Wage (UMP)** is the lower limit of monthly wages applicable throughout a province. It is set by the Governor.

segments.src: - **Upah Minimum Kabupaten/Kota (UMK)** adalah upah minimum untuk wilayah kabupaten atau kota tertentu. UMK ditetapkan gubernur atas rekomendasi bupati atau wali kota. Angkanya umumnya lebih tinggi daripada UMP.
segments.tr: - **Regency/City Minimum Wage (UMK)** is the minimum wage for a specific regency or city area. The UMK is set by the governor based on the recommendation of the regent or mayor. The figure is generally higher than the UMP.

segments.src: - **Upah Minimum Sektoral (UMSP/UMSK)** berlaku untuk sektor tertentu di tingkat provinsi atau kabupaten/kota. Penetapannya biasanya melalui kesepakatan perwakilan pekerja dan pengusaha di sektor tersebut.
segments.tr: - **Sectoral Minimum Wage (UMSP/UMSK)** applies to specific sectors at the provincial or regency/city level. Its determination is usually through an agreement between worker and employer representatives in that sector.

segments.src: Upah minimum berfungsi sebagai jaring pengaman.
segments.tr: The minimum wage functions as a safety net.

segments.src: Ketentuan ini terutama berlaku bagi pekerja dengan masa kerja kurang dari satu tahun.
segments.tr: This provision applies primarily to workers with less than one year of service.

segments.src: Pekerja yang sudah lebih lama bekerja seharusnya menerima upah sesuai struktur dan skala upah perusahaan.
segments.tr: Workers who have been employed longer should receive wages in accordance with the company's wage structure and scale.

segments.src: ## Komponen Rumus: Inflasi, Pertumbuhan Ekonomi, dan Indeks Tertentu
segments.tr: ## Formula Components: Inflation, Economic Growth, and Specific Indices

segments.src: Secara umum, rumus kenaikan upah minimum dalam regulasi terbaru terdiri dari tiga unsur utama:
segments.tr: In general, the minimum wage increase formula in the latest regulations consists of three main elements:

segments.src: 1. **Inflasi.** Komponen ini menjaga agar upah tidak tergerus kenaikan harga. Data yang dipakai bersumber dari Badan Pusat Statistik (BPS) untuk periode tertentu.
segments.tr: 1. **Inflation.** This component ensures that wages are not eroded by price increases. The data used is sourced from the Central Statistics Agency (BPS) for a certain period.

segments.src: 2. **Pertumbuhan ekonomi.** Komponen ini mencerminkan perkembangan ekonomi daerah, yaitu seberapa besar kue ekonomi yang bertambah.
segments.tr: 2. **Economic growth.** This component reflects regional economic development, which is how much the economic pie has grown.

segments.src: 3. **Indeks tertentu.** Ini adalah koefisien yang mengatur seberapa besar pertumbuhan ekonomi diperhitungkan dalam kenaikan upah. Nilainya berada dalam rentang yang ditetapkan pemerintah, dan sering disimbolkan dengan huruf Yunani alfa (α). Semakin tinggi nilainya, semakin besar kenaikan upah. Karena itu, rentang inilah yang paling sering menjadi bahan perdebatan.
segments.tr: 3. **Specific index.** This is a coefficient that regulates how much economic growth is taken into account in wage increases. Its value is within a range set by the government and is often symbolized by the Greek letter alpha (α). The higher the value, the greater the wage increase. Because of this, this range is most often the subject of debate.

segments.src: Secara sederhana, rumusnya dapat ditulis seperti berikut:
segments.tr: Simply put, the formula can be written as follows:

segments.src: Upah minimum tahun depan = Upah minimum tahun berjalan + Penyesuaian
segments.tr: Upah minimum tahun depan = Upah minimum tahun berjalan + Penyesuaian

segments.src: Penyesuaian = Upah minimum tahun berjalan × (Inflasi + (Pertumbuhan ekonomi × α))
segments.tr: Penyesuaian = Upah minimum tahun berjalan × (Inflasi + (Pertumbuhan ekonomi × α))

segments.src: ### Contoh Ilustrasi
segments.tr: ### Illustrative Example

segments.src: Angka berikut hanya contoh hitungan, bukan prediksi resmi:
segments.tr: The following figures are just calculation examples, not official predictions:

segments.src: - Upah minimum tahun berjalan: Rp3.000.000
segments.tr: - Current year's minimum wage: Rp3,000,000

segments.src: - Inflasi: 2,5%
segments.tr: - Inflation: 2.5%

segments.src: - Pertumbuhan ekonomi: 5%
segments.tr: - Economic growth: 5%

segments.src: - Indeks (α): 0,5
segments.tr: - Index (α): 0.5

segments.src: Dengan demikian, upah minimum tahun depan menjadi Rp3.150.000, atau naik 5%.
segments.tr: Thus, next year's minimum wage becomes Rp3,150,000, or an increase of 5%.

segments.src: Perubahan kecil pada nilai α sudah memengaruhi hasil akhir.
segments.tr: Small changes in the value of α already affect the final result.

segments.src: Jika α naik dari 0,5 menjadi 0,9, kenaikan pada contoh di atas bergeser dari 5% menjadi 7%.
segments.tr: If α increases from 0.5 to 0.9, the increase in the example above shifts from 5% to 7%.

segments.src: ### Peran Kebutuhan Hidup Layak dan Dewan Pengupahan
segments.tr: ### The Role of Decent Living Needs and the Wage Council

segments.src: Putusan Mahkamah Konstitusi atas uji materi UU Cipta Kerja menegaskan bahwa penetapan upah minimum harus memperhatikan kebutuhan hidup layak (KHL).
segments.tr: The Constitutional Court's decision on the judicial review of the Job Creation Law confirms that the determination of the minimum wage must take into account decent living needs (KHL).

segments.src: Putusan itu juga menegaskan peran dewan pengupahan daerah, yang beranggotakan unsur pemerintah, serikat pekerja, pengusaha, dan akademisi.
segments.tr: The ruling also emphasizes the role of the regional wage council, which consists of elements of the government, labor unions, employers, and academics.

segments.src: Karena itu, hasil hitungan rumus bukan satu-satunya dasar keputusan.
segments.tr: Therefore, the result of the formula calculation is not the only basis for the decision.

segments.src: Rekomendasi dewan pengupahan dan kondisi lokal ikut dipertimbangkan.
segments.tr: Recommendations from the wage council and local conditions are also taken into consideration.

segments.src: ## Jadwal Penetapan
segments.tr: ## Determination Schedule

segments.src: Tahapan penetapan upah minimum secara garis besar sebagai berikut:
segments.tr: The stages of determining the minimum wage are broadly as follows:

segments.src: 1. **Pengumpulan data.** BPS menyampaikan data inflasi dan pertumbuhan ekonomi, sementara pemerintah pusat menetapkan parameter rumus.
segments.tr: 1. **Data collection.** BPS provides inflation and economic growth data, while the central government sets the formula parameters.

segments.src: 2. **Pembahasan di dewan pengupahan.** Dewan pengupahan provinsi dan kabupaten/kota menggelar sidang, menghitung usulan, lalu menyampaikan rekomendasi kepada kepala daerah.
segments.tr: 2. **Discussion at the wage council.** The provincial and regency/city wage councils hold meetings, calculate proposals, and then submit recommendations to the regional head.

segments.src: 3. **Penetapan UMP.** Gubernur mengumumkan UMP. Pada tahun-tahun sebelumnya, pengumuman jatuh pada November, dan di beberapa tahun bergeser ke Desember karena penyesuaian regulasi.
segments.tr: 3. **UMP determination.** The Governor announces the UMP. In previous years, the announcement fell in November, and in some years it shifted to December due to regulatory adjustments.

segments.src: 4. **Penetapan UMK dan upah sektoral.** Penetapan ini mengikuti setelah UMP, juga dengan tenggat yang ditetapkan pemerintah.
segments.tr: 4. **UMK and sectoral wage determination.** This determination follows after the UMP, also with deadlines set by the government.

segments.src: 5. **Pemberlakuan.** Upah minimum baru berlaku mulai 1 Januari tahun berikutnya.
segments.tr: 5. **Enforcement.** The new minimum wage applies starting January 1 of the following year.

segments.src: Tenggat pastinya bisa berubah mengikuti regulasi terbaru.
segments.tr: The exact deadline can change following the latest regulations.

segments.src: Pembaca disarankan memantau pengumuman resmi Kementerian Ketenagakerjaan dan pemerintah daerah.
segments.tr: Readers are advised to monitor official announcements from the Ministry of Manpower and regional governments.

segments.src: ## Argumen Serikat Pekerja
segments.tr: ## Labor Union Arguments

segments.src: Serikat pekerja umumnya mendorong kenaikan yang lebih tinggi dengan sejumlah alasan:
segments.tr: Labor unions generally push for higher increases for several reasons:

segments.src: - **Daya beli.** Harga pangan, sewa tempat tinggal, transportasi, dan biaya pendidikan dinilai naik lebih cepat daripada upah.
segments.tr: - **Purchasing power.** Prices for food, rent, transportation, and education costs are considered to be rising faster than wages.

segments.src: - **Kebutuhan hidup layak.** Serikat meminta survei KHL di pasar benar-benar menjadi acuan, bukan hanya rumus makro.
segments.tr: - **Decent living needs.** Unions ask that the KHL survey in the market truly be a reference, not just a macro formula.

segments.src: - **Kesenjangan antardaerah.** Selisih upah yang lebar antarwilayah membuat pekerja di daerah berupah rendah makin tertinggal.
segments.tr: - **Inter-regional disparity.** The wide wage gap between regions leaves workers in low-wage areas further behind.

segments.src: - **Peran konsumsi domestik.** Kenaikan upah dinilai ikut menggerakkan konsumsi rumah tangga, yang menjadi penopang utama pertumbuhan ekonomi nasional.
segments.tr: - **Role of domestic consumption.** Wage increases are considered to help drive household consumption, which is the main pillar of national economic growth.

segments.src: ## Argumen Dunia Usaha
segments.tr: ## Business World Arguments

segments.src: Asosiasi pengusaha biasanya menekankan kehati-hatian dengan alasan berikut:
segments.tr: Business associations usually emphasize caution for the following reasons:

segments.src: - **Beban biaya.** Upah dan iuran yang mengikutinya, seperti jaminan sosial, adalah komponen biaya tetap. Kenaikan yang terlalu tinggi dikhawatirkan menekan margin, terutama bagi usaha kecil dan menengah.
segments.tr: - **Cost burden.** Wages and the contributions that follow, such as social security, are fixed cost components. Excessive increases are feared to squeeze margins, especially for small and medium enterprises.

segments.src: - **Daya saing.** Sektor padat karya seperti tekstil, alas kaki, dan manufaktur bersaing dengan negara lain. Kenaikan biaya tenaga kerja dikhawatirkan melemahkan daya saing ekspor.
segments.tr: - **Competitiveness.** Labor-intensive sectors such as textiles, footwear, and manufacturing compete with other countries. Increases in labor costs are feared to weaken export competitiveness.

segments.src: - **Kepastian usaha.** Pengusaha menginginkan rumus yang jelas dan dapat diprediksi agar perencanaan investasi dan perekrutan lebih terukur.
segments.tr: - **Business certainty.** Employers want a clear and predictable formula so that investment planning and recruitment are more measurable.

segments.src: - **Risiko pengurangan tenaga kerja.** Jika biaya naik tajam, sebagian pengusaha dapat menunda perekrutan, mengurangi jam kerja, atau menggeser usahanya ke daerah berupah lebih rendah.
segments.tr: - **Risk of workforce reduction.** If costs rise sharply, some employers may delay recruitment, reduce working hours, or shift their businesses to lower-wage areas.

segments.src: ## Mencari Titik Temu
segments.tr: ## Finding Common Ground

segments.src: Perdebatan upah minimum tidak sesederhana "pekerja melawan pengusaha".
segments.tr: The minimum wage debate is not as simple as "workers versus employers".

segments.src: Pemerintah harus menimbang beberapa kepentingan sekaligus:
segments.tr: The government must weigh several interests at once:

segments.src: - Menjaga daya beli tanpa memicu lonjakan biaya yang mengancam lapangan kerja.
segments.tr: - Maintaining purchasing power without triggering cost spikes that threaten jobs.

segments.src: - Mengurangi kesenjangan upah antardaerah tanpa mengabaikan perbedaan produktivitas.
segments.tr: - Reducing inter-regional wage disparities without ignoring productivity differences.

segments.src: - Memberi kepastian hukum dengan tetap menyisakan ruang bagi kondisi lokal.
segments.tr: - Providing legal certainty while still leaving room for local conditions.

segments.src: - Menyeimbangkan kenaikan upah dengan pekerja sektor informal, yang tidak terjangkau aturan upah minimum.
segments.tr: - Balancing wage increases with informal sector workers, who are not covered by minimum wage regulations.

segments.src: Para ekonom juga mengingatkan bahwa upah minimum hanyalah satu bagian dari kesejahteraan pekerja.
segments.tr: Economists also remind us that the minimum wage is only one part of worker welfare.

segments.src: Peningkatan produktivitas, pelatihan keterampilan, pengendalian harga kebutuhan pokok, dan perluasan lapangan kerja formal tak kalah penting.
segments.tr: Increasing productivity, skills training, controlling the prices of basic necessities, and expanding formal job opportunities are no less important.

segments.src: ## Yang Perlu Diperhatikan Pekerja dan Pengusaha
segments.tr: ## What Workers and Employers Need to Pay Attention To

id-20261027-international-logistics-tran.title: [Logistics and International Transportation #5] From Booking to Bill of Lading: How to Read a Container Shipping Freight Bill

segments.src: > Mengirim barang dengan kapal kontainer berjadwal (pelayaran liner) itu mirip memesan tiket pesawat: ada jadwal tetap, ada batas waktu yang tidak bisa ditawar, dan harga akhirnya hampir selalu lebih besar daripada tarif dasar yang pertama kali Anda lihat.
segments.tr: > Shipping cargo on a scheduled container ship (liner service) is much like booking an airline ticket: there is a fixed timetable, there are deadlines that cannot be negotiated, and the final price is almost always higher than the base rate you first saw.

segments.src: ## Konsep Hari Ini
segments.tr: ## Today's Concept

segments.src: **Pelayaran liner (liner shipping)** adalah layanan kapal yang berlayar dengan **rute dan jadwal tetap**, seperti bus antarkota yang berangkat dari terminal pada jam yang sudah diumumkan.
segments.tr: **Liner shipping** is a vessel service that sails on a **fixed route and schedule**, like an intercity bus that departs from the terminal at a published time.

segments.src: Kapal tetap berangkat walaupun tidak penuh.
segments.tr: The ship departs even when it is not full.

segments.src: Kebanyakan perdagangan barang jadi dunia, mulai dari pakaian, elektronik, sampai mebel, diangkut dengan kapal kontainer liner semacam ini.
segments.tr: Most of the world's trade in finished goods, from clothing and electronics to furniture, is carried by this kind of liner container ship.

segments.src: Lawannya adalah **tramp shipping**: kapal yang disewa sesuai kebutuhan, umumnya untuk muatan curah seperti batu bara atau gandum.
segments.tr: The opposite is **tramp shipping**: ships chartered as needed, generally for bulk cargo such as coal or grain.

segments.src: Supaya barang Anda bisa ikut kapal liner, ada urutan langkah yang umumnya seperti ini:
segments.tr: To get your cargo onto a liner ship, there is generally a sequence of steps like this:

segments.src: 1. **Booking request**: eksportir (atau freight forwarder yang mewakilinya) meminta ruang muat kepada perusahaan pelayaran. Isinya antara lain pelabuhan muat dan tujuan, jenis dan jumlah kontainer, jenis barang, serta perkiraan berat.
segments.tr: 1. **Booking request**: the exporter (or the freight forwarder acting for them) asks the shipping line for cargo space. It includes the port of loading and destination, the type and number of containers, the type of cargo, and the estimated weight.

segments.src: 2. **Booking confirmation**: pelayaran mengonfirmasi dan memberi **nomor booking**, nama kapal, nomor pelayaran (voyage), serta sederet **batas waktu (cut-off)**.
segments.tr: 2. **Booking confirmation**: the shipping line confirms and issues a **booking number**, the vessel name, the voyage number, and a series of **deadlines (cut-offs)**.

segments.src: 3. **Pengambilan kontainer kosong**: dengan dokumen pelepasan dari pelayaran, truk mengambil kontainer kosong di depo.
segments.tr: 3. **Pickup of empty container**: with a release document from the shipping line, a truck collects an empty container from the depot.

segments.src: 4. **Stuffing**: barang dimuat ke dalam kontainer, di gudang eksportir atau di gudang lain, lalu kontainer disegel.
segments.tr: 4. **Stuffing**: the cargo is loaded into the container, at the exporter's warehouse or another warehouse, and the container is sealed.

segments.src: 5. **Gate-in sebelum CY closing**: kontainer berisi harus masuk ke terminal sebelum batas waktu penerimaan (*container yard closing*). Kalau terlambat, kontainer bisa tertinggal kapal dan baru ikut kapal berikutnya.
segments.tr: 5. **Gate-in before CY closing**: the loaded container must enter the terminal before the receiving deadline (*container yard closing*). If it is late, it may be left behind by the ship and only board the next one.

segments.src: 6. **Shipping Instruction (SI) dan VGM**: eksportir mengirim data yang akan dicetak di dokumen pengapalan (pengirim, penerima, uraian barang, dan seterusnya) sebelum batas SI. Selain itu, sesuai aturan internasional SOLAS, **berat kotor kontainer yang sudah diverifikasi (VGM)** wajib dilaporkan sebelum kontainer dimuat ke kapal.
segments.tr: 6. **Shipping Instruction (SI) and VGM**: the exporter sends the data to be printed on the shipping documents (shipper, consignee, cargo description, and so on) before the SI deadline. In addition, under the international SOLAS rules, the **verified gross mass (VGM)** of the container must be reported before the container is loaded onto the ship.

segments.src: 7. **Pemuatan dan penerbitan Bill of Lading (B/L)**: setelah kapal berangkat, pelayaran menerbitkan B/L. Dokumen ini berfungsi sebagai tanda terima barang, bukti kontrak pengangkutan, dan (untuk B/L jenis tertentu) dokumen kepemilikan barang.
segments.tr: 7. **Loading and issuance of the Bill of Lading (B/L)**: once the ship has departed, the shipping line issues the B/L. This document serves as a receipt for the goods, proof of the contract of carriage, and (for certain types of B/L) a document of title to the goods.

segments.src: Lalu soal **biaya**.
segments.tr: Now, about **costs**.

segments.src: Tagihan pelayaran biasanya terdiri dari dua lapis:
segments.tr: The shipping line's charges usually consist of two layers:

segments.src: - **Ocean freight (tarif dasar)**: ongkos angkut laut per kontainer, umumnya dikutip dalam dolar AS, misalnya per kontainer 20 kaki atau 40 kaki.
segments.tr: - **Ocean freight (base rate)**: the sea transport charge per container, usually quoted in US dollars, for example per 20-foot or 40-foot container.

segments.src: - **Surcharge (biaya tambahan)**: komponen yang ditambahkan di atas tarif dasar. Yang paling sering muncul:
segments.tr: - **Surcharges (additional fees)**: components added on top of the base rate. The most frequent are:

segments.src: - **BAF** (*Bunker Adjustment Factor*): penyesuaian terhadap harga bahan bakar kapal.
segments.tr: - **BAF** (*Bunker Adjustment Factor*): an adjustment for the price of ship fuel.

segments.src: - **LSS** (*Low Sulphur Surcharge*): biaya untuk bahan bakar rendah sulfur sesuai aturan IMO 2020. Sebagian pelayaran menggabungkannya ke dalam BAF.
segments.tr: - **LSS** (*Low Sulphur Surcharge*): a charge for low-sulphur fuel under IMO 2020 rules. Some shipping lines fold it into the BAF.

segments.src: - **CAF** (*Currency Adjustment Factor*): penyesuaian terhadap fluktuasi kurs.
segments.tr: - **CAF** (*Currency Adjustment Factor*): an adjustment for exchange rate fluctuations.

segments.src: - **PSS** (*Peak Season Surcharge*): biaya musim ramai, saat permintaan ruang kapal melonjak.
segments.tr: - **PSS** (*Peak Season Surcharge*): a charge for the busy season, when demand for ship space surges.

segments.src: - **THC** (*Terminal Handling Charge*): biaya penanganan kontainer di terminal, ditagih di pelabuhan asal dan di pelabuhan tujuan.
segments.tr: - **THC** (*Terminal Handling Charge*): the charge for handling containers at the terminal, billed at both the port of origin and the port of destination.

segments.src: Ada juga **GRI** (*General Rate Increase*), yaitu kenaikan tarif dasar secara umum yang diumumkan pelayaran untuk suatu rute.
segments.tr: There is also the **GRI** (*General Rate Increase*), a general increase in the base rate announced by the shipping line for a route.

segments.src: Jadi saat membandingkan penawaran, pertanyaan pentingnya adalah: **"Ini tarif dasar saja, atau sudah *all-in*?"**
segments.tr: So when comparing offers, the key question is: **"Is this just the base rate, or is it already *all-in*?"**

segments.src: Terakhir, siapa yang membayar ongkos angkut laut: **freight prepaid** berarti dibayar di pelabuhan asal (biasanya oleh pengirim), sedangkan **freight collect** berarti dibayar di tujuan (biasanya oleh penerima).
segments.tr: Finally, on who pays the ocean freight: **freight prepaid** means it is paid at the port of origin (usually by the shipper), while **freight collect** means it is paid at the destination (usually by the consignee).

segments.src: Ketentuan ini biasanya mengikuti Incoterms yang disepakati dalam kontrak jual beli.
segments.tr: These terms usually follow the Incoterms agreed in the sales contract.

segments.src: ## Dalam Kehidupan Sehari-hari
segments.tr: ## In Everyday Life

segments.src: Bayangkan Bu Rina, pemilik usaha mebel kayu di **Jepara**.
segments.tr: Imagine Ms. Rina, the owner of a wooden furniture business in **Jepara**.

segments.src: Ia mendapat pesanan dari pembeli di **Rotterdam** dan sepakat menjual dengan syarat CIF, artinya Bu Rina yang menanggung ongkos kirim laut sampai pelabuhan tujuan.
segments.tr: She received an order from a buyer in **Rotterdam** and agreed to sell on CIF terms, meaning she bears the sea freight cost up to the destination port.

segments.src: Lewat forwarder di Semarang, ia memesan satu kontainer 40 kaki dari **Pelabuhan Tanjung Emas**.
segments.tr: Through a forwarder in Semarang, she booked one 40-foot container from **Tanjung Emas Port**.

segments.src: Konfirmasi booking datang dengan catatan: CY closing hari Kamis pukul 12.00, batas SI hari Rabu.
segments.tr: The booking confirmation came with a note: CY closing on Thursday at 12:00, SI deadline on Wednesday.

segments.src: Truk mengambil kontainer kosong di depo Semarang, mebel dimuat di gudangnya di Jepara, lalu kontainer dikirim ke terminal.
segments.tr: A truck picked up the empty container at the Semarang depot, the furniture was loaded at her warehouse in Jepara, and the container was then delivered to the terminal.

segments.src: Karena jalur pantura sedang padat, sopir berangkat sehari lebih awal.
segments.tr: Because the northern coast road (pantura) was congested, the driver set off a day early.

segments.src: Kalau terlambat melewati CY closing, kontainernya bisa tertinggal kapal, dan pembelinya di Belanda harus menunggu jadwal kapal berikutnya.
segments.tr: If the container arrived after CY closing, it could be left behind by the ship, and the buyer in the Netherlands would have to wait for the next scheduled sailing.

segments.src: Saat menerima penawaran harga, Bu Rina hampir tertipu oleh angka kecil.
segments.tr: When receiving the price quote, Ms. Rina nearly got caught out by a small number.

segments.src: Ocean freight 40' Semarang–Rotterdam   USD 2.000
segments.tr: Ocean freight 40' Semarang–Rotterdam   USD 2.000

segments.src: BAF/LSS                                USD   400
segments.tr: BAF/LSS                                USD   400

segments.src: PSS (musim ramai)                      USD   300
segments.tr: PSS (musim ramai)                      USD   300

segments.tr: THC Tanjung Emas                       Rp  2.500.000 (contoh)

segments.tr: Biaya dokumen (B/L)                    Rp    500.000 (contoh)

segments.src: Forwarder lain menawarkan "USD 2.100", tetapi setelah ditanya ternyata itu belum termasuk BAF dan PSS.
segments.tr: Another forwarder offered "USD 2,100", but after asking, it turned out this did not include the BAF and PSS.

segments.src: Sejak itu Bu Rina selalu meminta rincian lengkap, termasuk biaya yang ditagih dalam rupiah, sebelum menghitung harga jual ke pembelinya.
segments.tr: Since then, Ms. Rina always asks for a complete breakdown, including any charges billed in rupiah, before calculating the selling price to her buyer.

segments.src: ## 3 Poin Ringkas
segments.tr: ## 3 Key Points

segments.src: 1. Pelayaran liner berjalan dengan jadwal tetap, sehingga eksportir wajib mematuhi batas waktu seperti CY closing dan batas SI.
segments.tr: 1. Liner shipping runs on a fixed schedule, so exporters must comply with deadlines such as CY closing and the SI deadline.

segments.src: 2. Alurnya: booking → konfirmasi → ambil kontainer kosong → stuffing → gate-in → SI dan VGM → muat kapal → Bill of Lading.
segments.tr: 2. The flow: booking → confirmation → pick up empty container → stuffing → gate-in → SI and VGM → loading onto the ship → Bill of Lading.

segments.src: 3. Total ongkos kirim = tarif dasar + surcharge (BAF, LSS, CAF, PSS, THC, dan lain-lain), jadi bandingkan penawaran berdasarkan biaya *all-in*.
segments.tr: 3. Total shipping cost = base rate + surcharges (BAF, LSS, CAF, PSS, THC, and others), so compare offers on an *all-in* basis.

segments.tr: ## ✅ Self-Quiz

segments.src: - A. Kapal menunggu sampai kontainer dimuat
segments.tr: - A. The ship waits until the container is loaded

segments.src: - B. Kontainer berisiko tertinggal dan dialihkan ke kapal berikutnya
segments.tr: - B. The container risks being left behind and rolled over to the next ship

segments.src: - C. Ongkos kirim otomatis dikembalikan
segments.tr: - C. The shipping cost is automatically refunded

segments.src: - D. Bill of Lading tetap terbit untuk kapal tersebut
segments.tr: - D. The Bill of Lading is still issued for that ship

segments.tr: **2.** True or false: BAF is an additional charge to adjust the shipping cost for changes in the price of ship fuel.

segments.src: ## 📚 Istilah Hari Ini
segments.tr: ## 📚 Today's Terms

segments.src: - **Pelayaran liner**: layanan kapal dengan rute dan jadwal tetap yang terbuka untuk banyak pengirim.
segments.tr: - **Liner shipping**: a vessel service with fixed routes and schedules, open to many shippers.

segments.src: - **CY closing (cut-off)**: batas waktu terakhir kontainer berisi diterima di terminal agar bisa ikut kapal yang dipesan.
segments.tr: - **CY closing (cut-off)**: the final deadline by which a loaded container must be received at the terminal to board the booked ship.

segments.src: - **VGM (Verified Gross Mass)**: berat kotor kontainer yang sudah diverifikasi dan wajib dilaporkan sebelum dimuat, sesuai aturan SOLAS.
segments.tr: - **VGM (Verified Gross Mass)**: the verified gross weight of a container, which must be reported before loading under SOLAS rules.

segments.src: - **Surcharge**: biaya tambahan di atas tarif dasar, misalnya BAF, CAF, PSS, atau THC.
segments.tr: - **Surcharge**: an additional charge on top of the base rate, such as BAF, CAF, PSS, or THC.

segments.src: - **Bill of Lading (B/L)**: dokumen dari pengangkut yang berfungsi sebagai tanda terima barang, bukti kontrak pengangkutan, dan dapat menjadi dokumen kepemilikan barang.
segments.tr: - **Bill of Lading (B/L)**: a document issued by the carrier that serves as a receipt for the goods, proof of the contract of carriage, and may act as a document of title to the goods.
